question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word in the given sentence.

He is just __jealous__ that he didn’t get picked for the job.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"jealous"** means feeling or showing envy of someone or their achievements and advantages. (ईर्ष्यालु)

 
 
• **Example: **She was** jealous** of her sister's success.
 
 
 
• **"Envious"** refers to feeling or showing envy, similar to jealousy. (ईर्ष्यालु)
 
 
• **Example: **He was** envious** of his friend's new car.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. envious.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Suspicious** (संदेहपूर्ण): Having or showing a cautious distrust of someone or something.

 
 
• **Example:** She was suspicious of his intentions.
 
 
 
• **Greedy** (लालची): Having an excessive desire for something, especially wealth or food.
 
 
• **Example: **His greedy nature led him to accumulate vast wealth unethically.
 
 
 
• **Spiteful** (द्वेषपूर्ण): Showing or caused by malice.
 
 
• **Example:** Her spiteful comments were meant to hurt her opponent's feelings.
